lines.trans: Stepanych, I will soon become a federal minister!
What ministry specifically will you head?
The ministry of fisheries of the whole country!
Well look at that, real good luck!
Even I did not expect such a gift.
I congratulate you from all my heart.
This is a real gold mine after all!
Yes, this opens huge opportunities.
Now we will solve absolutely all problems.
First one must finish an important matter.
Are we going right now?
Yes, let's go to the residence immediately.
Where exactly are we heading right now?
It is time to make our move before influential people.

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
It is time to make our move before influential people.
The governor met with an influential politician.

meanings.en: to head, lead, take charge of

examples.trans: What ministry specifically will you head?
The experienced general took charge of the army.

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

meanings.note: lowest part of a body of water

examples.trans: Found him on the bottom of the river.
Why are you hovering over me?

ехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to drive, to ride

meanings.en: to go, to drive, to ride
meanings.note: by car, bus, train, in one direction, now

examples.trans: Vitalik, we're going to the Santa Fe.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

meanings.en: to finish, to end, to complete

examples.trans: I want to finish what I started.
He's very good with his hands.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!
for movement; где is for location

examples.trans: What ministry specifically are they offering me?
The official works in the ministry of finance.
They are considering you for the post of minister.
The new minister held the first meeting.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)
must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.
Where exactly are we heading right now?
The car was heading toward the railway station.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

обозначиться.gloss: to make a move, show oneself

meanings.en: to make oneself known, assert presence

examples.trans: You must urgently make your financial move.
The candidate quickly asserted his presence before the leadership.

meanings.note: + genitive or accusative: я не ожидал = I didn't expect (that)
a door, window, bottle, or business

examples.trans: I'm going to open it now.
They open the shop at nine.
I'm standing in front of you.
There's a car in front of the house.
This is a present for you.

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)

meanings.note: + infinitive: Пора идти = Time to go

examples.trans: It's time for us to go.
Let's go to the residence immediately.

examples.text: В загородной резиденции состоялся важный приём.
examples.trans: An important reception took place at the country residence.

examples.trans: The ministry of fisheries of the whole country!

examples.trans: Delicious fish soup was served for lunch.

Let's start everything from the beginning.

examples.trans: That's a real stroke of luck.

The federal service is conducting the investigation.
The ministry of fisheries develops the industry.

examples.text: Фермер успешно ведёт своё сельское хозяйство.
